text:
Jordan M.: Hey team — I need to add my stepdaughter to medical and dental but we don't have the formal custody decree yet. Is there an alternative set of documents that will work for proof? I'm still within 30 days after the QLE.
Lina (People Ops): Congrats, Jordan! :tada: Yes there are alternate docs, we can accept several types as temporary evidence while you get the decree.
Jordan M.: Awesome — what exactly counts? I can get school records and a guardian letter from my spouse.
Amrita K.: For stepkids we typically accept one primary and one secondary document. Primary = birth certificate showing parentage OR court order. Secondary = school records, medical records, court appointment of guardian, adoption paperwork, or a letter from a licensed social worker.
Ken L.: Re: timeline — Jordan, because you reported within 30 days of the QLE you're eligible for a midyear enrollment change. We just need the scanned docs uploaded within 60 days for final verification or benefits may be reversed on payroll.
Jordan M.: Thanks — is there a secure place to upload? I don't want to email PDFs.
people-ops-bot: Secure upload link generated: https://benefits.redwood.com/secure-upload/JM-1843200000 (expires in 14 days).
Lina (People Ops): Use that link. In the upload form choose "Qualifying Life Event - Dependent Addition" and add a short note that these are temporary supporting docs pending custody decree. We'll flag the case for the benefits admin.
Amrita K.: If you only have one secondary doc now (e.g., school record) upload it and put expected timeline to get the decree in the notes. That will buy you provisional coverage while we review.
Jordan M.: Got it. Do I need to complete any enrollment screens in the portal too?
Lina (People Ops): Yes — after you submit docs go to Benefits > Manage Dependents in the portal and start the "Add Dependent due to QLE" flow. Select the plans you want. You'll see the effective date options (usually retro to the QLE date or start of next pay period).
Ken L.: Payroll FYI: if payroll needs to be adjusted midmonth we might prorate premiums. People Ops will send a confirmation once benefits are active so you can check your next paystub.
Jordan M.: Thanks everyone — I'll upload school record now and update when we have the decree.
Lina (People Ops): Thanks! Ping me here if you hit issues. I'll create an internal case and follow up with benefits admin.
people-ops-bot: Case created: PO-6721 — Benefits admin notified.
Jordan M.: Appreciated :pray:
